# Original LEZAC.EXE level-2 behaviour-4 (kind-2 flyer) motion evidence.
#
# Captured in-container under DOSBox, tick-locked on the frame counter
# DS:0x78C2 with ONE 64 KiB pread of the data segment per tick. Sampled from
# the REAL actor table DS:0x1BAE stride 0x26 -- NOT DS:0x74A8, which is the
# level-file monster spawner table; reading actor state out of 0x74A8 is what
# produced the withdrawn bomb-fuse claim.
#
# Record layout, recovered from the bytes that actually move over the 666
# behaviour-4 ticks (only these offsets ever change):
#   +0x06 i16 vx        +0x08 i16 vy
#   +0x0A u8  x fraction (8.8 carry)   +0x0C u8 y fraction
#   +0x16 u8  animation frame          +0x19 u8 animation delay counter
# Constant across the run: +0x00 kind=2, +0x15 behaviour=4, +0x0E = 0x0e
# retarget period, +0x17/+0x18 = 0x28/0x2a animation range. The fraction is a
# single BYTE (the neighbouring bytes never move), the same integer-pixel +
# byte-fraction model the port already uses for monsters.
#
# RNG ATTRIBUTION IS CLEAN, contrary to a first reading of this capture: 616
# of the 666 ticks advance the shared LCG by ZERO steps, 48 advance it by
# exactly 2, and one by 4. The two live kind-1 walkers draw nothing while
# walking, so the two draws on a retarget tick are the flyer's own.
#
# Velocity selection, recovered: vx and vy are each
#   value = -ai1 + Random(2*ai1)   with ai1 = 271
# taking the FIRST draw for vx and the SECOND for vy. That reproduces 47/48
# vx and 43/48 vy; every exception is a contact rule applied to the same tick
# AFTER selection -- five vy exceptions are the top-edge clamp to vy = 1
# (frames 393, 407, 617, 631, 645) and the single vx exception at frame 911 is
# a horizontal bounce. The level-2 kind-2 spawner carries param0Base=13
# param0Range=2 (so ai0 is 13 or 14; the capture shows 14 = the retarget
# period) and param1Base=270 param1Range=2 (so ai1 is 270 or 271; the capture
# shows 271).
#
# Corroborated contact rules, from the 25 velocity changes that consumed NO
# RNG: a horizontal bounce of -vx/2 (observed -182 -> +91, -221 -> +110) and a
# top-edge clamp to vy = 1.
